annual.label: Average yearly repair cost for the 750Li (RepairPal)

maint.job: Synthetic oil and filter change (BMW-approved oil)
maint.every: About every 10,000 miles or once a year (follow the service reminder)
maint.note: V8 and V12 engines hold more oil. Many owners change it sooner, around 5,000-7,500 miles, on turbo engines.

maint.job: Front brake pads, rotors and wear sensor
maint.note: Big, heavy car with large rotors, so brakes cost more than on smaller BMWs.

maint.job: Rear brake pads, rotors and wear sensor
maint.note: Newer cars have an electronic parking brake that needs a scan tool for pad service.
The battery sits in the trunk and must be registered to the car with a scan tool.

maint.every: About every 30,000-40,000 miles on V8/V12; about 60,000 miles on newer 6-cylinders

maint.note: The E38 guide recommends a coolant flush every 3 years.
